uncosted_material_changes: NAT, interface endpoints, VPN, ALB, paid tracking servers, GPUs, always-on endpoints and provisioned concurrency are not selected or included.

A full historical backfill or a higher-priced qualified model needs a new reservation and cost calculation.

data_options.price_claim_scope: Displayed current personal pricing card; not an activated subscription or all-use licence.
Primary support article reports starting price; current purchase/billing/rights need confirmation.
Option visible, exact price not independently verified.
Considered development option; no UK/India live scope or complete licence proven.

budget_verdict.meaning: Grow 79 plus AWS already exceeds GBP 70 planned operation under central FX/tax assumptions; optional Claude blocked without verified credit. Support-reported Grow 55 could fit numerically, but current price, exact rights/coverage, runtime and workload remain unproven. No complete architecture or budget approval.

estimate_assumptions.scope: Queue/scheduler requests, configuration retrieval, registry storage, temporary training volumes, audit data events and messaging; exact workload and tariff verification pending.
External domain registration allowance; exact TLD, provider and invoice unknown.

unit_convention: Each usd_rate is USD per ONE stated unit, never implicitly per thousand or per million. Quantities are total billed units over the30-day scenario; GB-month lines already express time-weighted storage. Reference currency conversion multiplies total USD by GBP/USD, tax and card factors once.
